title: The Ministry of Sufficient Dignity
setting_summary: In the chronically underheated Tower of Proportional Remedies, a government bureau processes citizens' claims to their own human dignity using Form D-1, a single overburdened elevator, and a filing system that predates the building's electricity. Every right must be requested, stamped, appealed, and re-stamped within a strict forty-eight-hour window, and the tower's surveillance clerks record each sigh as a potential procedural violation.
